name: Paris-Orly

runway.v: Three runways: 06/24 3,650 m x 45 m, 07/25 3,320 m x 45 m, 02/20 2,400 m x 45 m (June 2025 AIP copy). Runway 4 (north) closed until 17 Dec 2026.

curfew.v: Night curfew: no departure from the parking stand after 23:15 local (order of 4 July 2025); take-offs banned 23:30-06:00 local (June 2025 AIP copy). From 22:00 only the quietest aircraft may land or take off. Exemptions only for safety, security or public order.
curfew.quote: La redéfinition du couvre-feu nocturne, désormais fondé sur l'heure de départ du poste de stationnement (23h15)

noise.v: Partial curfew from 22:00 local: only the quietest aircraft may land and take off after 22:00.
noise.quote: seuls les aéronefs les plus vertueux pourront atterrir et décoller après 22h

customs.v: Customs and immigration 24 hours (June 2025 AIP copy).
customs.quote: Douanes et police / Customs and immigration H24

fuel.v: No fuelling 22:30-05:00 except by special arrangement with the fuel services (June 2025 AIP copy).
fuel.quote: Not provided between 2230 and 0500, except special arrangement with local fuelling services.

notes: Current AIP AD 2 LFPO (29 Oct 2026) could not be opened; runway, customs and fuel are from the DIRCAM copy of the AIP (AIRAC 06/25, 12 Jun 2025) and the curfew from the ministry's July 2025 press release. Exact current curfew hours (arrivals end, morning end) and the 22:00 quiet-aircraft list must be checked in the current AIP before quoting. Orly runway 4 (north) closed until 17 Dec 2026 inclusive (ministry, updated 12 Aug 2026). Orly is slot-coordinated (COHOR) but this was not verified in the source.
